scopes.title: Calibration coordinates and literal release configurations

scopes.title: Selected empirical MODEL000 conventions and unresolved executable semantics
scopes.checked_claim: Guy Sec2 Eq1 (PDF2) defines F=x0[M0+x1M1+...]exp(c CL(lambda)), rest-frame phase since B maximum and rest-frame wavelength. Sec4.3 (PDF4–5) gives historical construction range−20..+50 days and2000..9200 Angstrom. Brout Sec4.1 states B21 Pantheon+ fitting3000..7000 Angstrom. Selected c447 MODEL000 SALT2.INFO separately records RESTLAMBDA_RANGE2800 7000, COLORLAW_VERSION1,4 printed color coefficients, MAG_OFFSET0.27 and interpolation/error-map options; compressed selected assets are pinned, with first8 lines only inspected. Release README distinguishes nominal MODEL000 from9 systematic variants.
scopes.unresolved: These three domains have distinct roles. Full MODEL000 grid support/endpoints/counts, phase/wavelength column correspondence, flux units and normalization, version1 executable color-law polynomial/extrapolation, error-map units/normalization/interpolation and covariance closure require a pinned source reader or author format definition. Guy Sec6 variance/covariance equations supply historical empirical context, not a decoder for B21 relative-error files. SALT color can combine intrinsic variation and extinction; it is not uniquely physical dust. No first-principles luminosity law, detector probability or censoring likelihood is accepted.

limitations: Targeted original-source claims only; zero new Luna/full-paper reads or paper promotions. Existing queues and original assets remain intact.

Paper locators: Brout2112.03864v2 Sec2.1/2.3/2.4/2.7, Sec3.1 Eqs4–5, Sec3.2, Sec3.3/Table3, Sec4.1/4.3 and AppendixA; Guyastro-ph/0701828v1 Sec2 Eq1/2.1/2.2, selected Sec3.1/3.2, Sec4.1–4.3, Sec5 and Sec6/6.1/6.2. Coverage is bounded; training tables, cited primary calibrator/survey papers and Taylor2112.03863v2 are unread in this wave.

Calibration ancestry includes overlapping tertiary stars, CALSPEC/NGSL synthetic magnitudes, passbands, extinction correction, zero-centered priors, relative survey weights and uncertainty floors. Brout Sec3.2 selection cuts are conditioning, not a complete survey selection probability.

Nine correlated zeropoint/effective-wavelength mock realizations are systematic perturbations propagated jointly through retraining and fitting. Paper Sec4.3 sigma_k=1/3 and selected ALL.fitopts literal0.3 are kept distinct; neither is an observed probability mass.
shift_0.dat has nonzero perturbations; its suffix does not certify a zero shift or a mapping to nominal MODEL000. Generator/index bridge unexamined.
The original Guy color-law convention CL(lambda_B)=0 and CL(lambda_V)=0.4 log(10) is historical context; no silent mapping to the later version1 four-coefficient release convention.

Release FILTSYSTEM COUNT and MAGSYSTEM AB/BD17 are configuration literals, not measured quantum efficiency, gain or extraction/censoring laws. Both PS1 and Foundation configs use SURVEY PS1MD, with differing g-filter filenames and offsets.

Covariances/uncertainties depend on training, calibration and selection. No independent datasets, stochastic optical-state law, global empirical-template accuracy or held-out validation are established.
